nodes.name: bundle
nodes.notes: No ingest/reconstruct/export-cog Node exists yet to wire as {in.x}, so the source Orthomosaic/splat/showcase/report/vendor-asset paths are read from the BUNDLE_ORTHO / BUNDLE_SPLAT_SCENE / BUNDLE_SPLAT_META / BUNDLE_SHOWCASE / BUNDLE_SPRITE / BUNDLE_REPORT / BUNDLE_VENDOR_DIR env vars (see nodes/bundle/build.py). At least one of BUNDLE_ORTHO, BUNDLE_SPLAT_SCENE or BUNDLE_SHOWCASE is required.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.notes: Publishes for real. The bucket wayfinder-delivery-ca-east exists in B2 CA-East, is allPrivate with SSE-B2, and carries the CORS rules the viewer needs. Credentials come from ~/.config/wayfinder/b2-delivery.env on the machine that runs this.
